scope: G3 functional branch only: actual test-only dispatch of the closed direct worker V1 publisher over a real bootstrapped C cut; no production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch

implementation: Slice 2 test joins: one retained legacy owner row is published in the original journal and the actual content repository, then copied into C by two direct bootstrap windows; the closed worker publisher then publishes the next V1 owner version in exactly one NV dispatch, and the repository's verified state equals the returned state

A revoked original check, a Select-purpose source, a substituted owner binding, a stale review attribution and an anonymous operation are each refused before any allocation or NV dispatch; the exact original then publishes

Old, lost and third-party NV replies after the sole dispatch are fenced: all new content was allocated before dispatch, no redispatch occurs, a cold reopen fails and the repository keeps the prior verified state
A cold reopen refuses the V1 publication event class because no independent lineage verifier for it exists yet; the warm publisher is not a cold reader
Production change is one comment in the direct backend; the test module widens three existing test helpers and the content guard to pub(super)

environment.storage: Disposable private ext4 work directories on drive D
environment.authority: Explicit software worker attribution, resource lease and NV fixtures, not installed original PAM, physical TPM or loaded LSM qualification

slice2_regression.dispatched: test builds only; no production caller

not_claimed: A cold lineage verifier for the V1 publication event class; a cold reopen after a worker publication fails closed
A production caller of the worker publisher, an installed run or native C activation
C owner migration, delta overlay, snapshot backup delivery or a V2 owner creation route
Artifact CLI harness passage, installed PAM, physical TPM, loaded LSM or Hyper-V qualification
Any produced image or GWIN0 package; G3 and GWIN0 remain open

retained_failed_attempts.cause: The new test file had one unformatted use line (14 diff lines), and all three tests panicked with InvalidProvenance because an external edit was planned with managed-capture provenance
retained_failed_attempts.correction: Test-side only: wrap the use line and give the provenance fixture an explicit origin (managed for capture, external for edits)
